content: I have added https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/42468#issuecomment-5188050414, it is intended to cover plethysm concepts. For the current purpose, decided to restrict to simpler case with Q so that it would be a smaller addition
Did you use AI in any way? About the mathematical content, I think mathlib would like to have the full theory of lambda-rings, not just the case of algebras over the rationals.
Yes Claude code as described there. I thought having the extra calc steps for manipulating all the Pn and Pnm universal polynomials would be too much for now and i could do that part later

I would think that the basic definitions of (non special) λ\lambdaλ-rings should follow a similar pattern as divided powers docs#DividedPowers. Then, I do not know precisely how to structure the definitions and proofs about the universal polynomials that are involved with special λ\lambdaλ-rings, but this should require a special care. I am not convinced that the Adams operations should involve new data: I believe that should be defined from the λ\lambdaλ-operations.

Yea they should be defined from \lambda operations when do integrally and yes to not having decided exactly what definitions to use for special (especially bc of lack of fixed choices between pre,special,default across different subjects and i would prefer calling non special as pre). Am open to discussion about what exactly is needed. I wouldnt have even given pre-lambda rings a definition bc of my typical uses. Where it has the even more structure but others would not demand that much

Suggestions? Would having a version with rationals incorporated now and then doing a integral version when know exactly which definition to use be a problem? An of... to convert without causing anything too breaking. Or would it be preferred to just decide which definition now?
As I have said above, I do not think it makes sense to have definitions of Adams operations if we do not have the basic API for (pre)-λ\lambdaλ-rings!
